channel.title: LiveNow from Fox - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from LiveNow from Fox (livenowfox.com)

item.title: Jury finds Bill Cosby sexually assaulted woman in 1972, victim awarded $19M
item.description: A civil jury found Bill Cosby liable for a 1972 sexual assault and awarded the victim $19.25 million in damages.

item.title: Several states sue Trump administration over ability to regulate greenhouse gases
item.description: A coalition of states is suing the Trump administration after the EPA rolled back a key 2009 climate finding on greenhouse gases.

item.title: Senate confirms Markwayne Mullin as DHS secretary amid funding shutdown
item.description: The Senate has confirmed Markwayne Mullin as Secretary of Homeland Security, placing him in charge of an agency facing a funding shutdown.

item.title: No tips, worse service? Restaurant owners warn trend is 'degrading' dining experience
item.description: As more restaurants experiment with eliminating tips, the idea of a no-tip dining model is gaining traction — but not without resistance from some industry professionals who fear it could drag down service.

item.title: Live updates: Trump lifts hopes for war to wind down as Iran denies negotiations
item.description: President Donald Trump said government officials were holding productive talks with Tehran, but Iran denied there were discussions as the war continues.

item.title: Popular cruise line abruptly changes 20 of its voyages, disrupting vacations
item.description: Royal Caribbean scrapped the itineraries for 20 upcoming voyages, impacting thousands of passengers.

item.title: Trader Joe's recalls over 9M pounds of vegetable fried rice sold in 43 states due to glass contamination
item.description: The new recall of Trader Joe's frozen vegetable fried rice products affects multiple states, including Arizona, Colorado, Illinois, and Georgia.

item.title: USDA issues alert for ground beef over possible metal contamination
item.description: The U.S. Department of Agriculture has issued a public health alert for certain grass-fed ground beef sold in several states due to possible metal contamination.

item.title: When it comes to morality, there’s one thing almost all Americans think is wrong, Pew poll finds
item.description: A new survey examining Americans’ moral qualms with a number of issues found one matter that nearly everyone could agree on: don’t cheat on your spouse.

item.title: Ford recalls more than 250,000 SUVs for software issues, NHTSA says
item.description: Ford’s new recall affects certain model Lincoln Navigator, Lincoln Nautilus, Lincoln Aviator and Ford Explorer SUVs manufactured between 2022 and 2025.
